text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo and Tokai Teio. Unfortunately, 
neither of them was able to take the 
victory...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah... My dream... The Japanese Derby 
is...~...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Turbo's dream is gone~ My Derpy 
is gone~...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Come to think of it, I don't think 
Turbo's dream was the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Well, whatever! It was kinda fun anyway!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm back, Trainer. Turbo tried her best, 
but it didn't work out.
choice_data_list: Good work. But you did really well.
Good work. But you did great.

text_block_list.text:
I offer words of appreciation while 
thinking to myself. Perhaps for today's 
race choice, instead of aiming too high 
with the Japanese Derby, we should have...
choice_data_list: Would an easier race have been better?
Would an easier race have been better?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "Conditions? Like races that aren't GⅠ?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but still~... Turbo thinks this was 
good! I mean, it was fun!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Instead of running away from a giant wall, 
it's better to crash right into it and 
lose! That's the Turbo way!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: And what's more!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Conditions don't matter—when Turbo's gonna 
lose, she's gonna lose! So don't you worry 
about a thing!

...It was just as they said. Everything 
depends on the race dynamic and mood. So, 
maybe this was for the best.
And after the Winning Live concluded...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hm, Trainer. Someone's coming. Is that...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Out of the way...! Sorry, move! Please, 
get out of the way!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let me through, please!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
How rare to see the President get so 
flustered. Did something happen?

A chill crept down my spine. I had a bad 
feeling. And then—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh, Tokai Teio got a fracture~ !?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: How could this be... Not Teio...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
She might not even be able to run in the 
Kikuka-sho...? You've gotta be kidding 
me...

That shocking news sent massive ripples 
through not just Tracen Academy, but 
society as a whole.

"If Tokai Teio is absent this autumn, the 
entire landscape of the Classic Triple 
Crown will shift drastically, but..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Turbo, Trainer-san. I have an update... 
about Teio.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"It sounds like she's not giving up on 
entering the Kikuka-sho. We don't know if 
she can make it, but both she and her team 
are going to do their best."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I see, I see. Well...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo knew it all along, though!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh, you look awfully confident!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, that's Tokai Teio we're talking 
about. There's no way a broken bone is 
gonna make her give up."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, Nature! Turbo and the 
gang gotta get to work! Right, Trainer?

Summer training camp season is 
approaching. On top of that, our target 
race, the Radio NIKKEI Sho, is drawing 
near.

"Of course I'm concerned about our rivals, 
but we can't afford to get entirely caught 
up in that."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're right... There's nothing we can do 
for Teio. All we can do is...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"All that matters is getting stronger! Why 
am I worrying about Teio when she's 
already so far ahead of me!?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: All right, let's do it, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Turbo and the gang just gotta burst 
forward with all our might toward autumn!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Nature, both of you believe in 
Turbo and follow my lead!

Twin Turbo remained endlessly positive. 
Undeterred by Tokai Teio's setback, she 
keeps barreling down her own path.
